description: Look up a UK medicine by exact dm+d code or by a substring of its name. Returns the dm+d product, its current severity tier (the highest government act in force, with citation), and its supply events (MSN / SSP / price concession), newest first. Provide `code` or `name`.

code.description: An exact dm+d code (VMP identifier), e.g. "42381011000001106".

name.description: A case-insensitive substring of the medicine name, e.g. "ramipril".

name: lookup_product
title: Look up a medicine
